whenToUse: Task priorities, menu order, or playlists.
People need to set the order themselves.
There are a few dozen items or fewer.
whenNotToUse: The sort order is fixed by a criterion (use data table sorting).
There are very many items (use buttons such as Move to top).
Moving to another list (use a kanban board).

alternatives.name: Kanban Board
alternatives.reason: Moving to a list with a different status.

accessibility: The handle is a named button and moves one place with ↑/↓.
After a move, announce the new position with role="status", such as "1st of 4".
Focus stays on the moved item's handle.
It's an ol list, so the order is read along with it.
